response:
Reorganized the controls: document menus now offer Rename, Export, and Delete, while retaining Pin and Archive. The editor’s three-dot menu is gone, with a dedicated focus-mode button in the header. Help now links to keyboard shortcuts, and the affected guides reflect the new locations.

Lint and typecheck passed with two existing navigation warnings. The Word and PDF download test and focus-mode tests passed; the caret-position test passed on rerun after an initial failure.

Updated Help navigation to point to Settings → Help, removed the duplicate shortcuts link, and made the settings back arrow return to Documents. Individual help guides still return to the Help section.

Removed the sample privacy text and changed “Forgot?” to “Forgot password?” on sign-in.

Lint and typecheck passed with two existing warnings. The settings back-navigation test passed at desktop, tablet, and mobile sizes.

Removed “Start writing” from the landing-page header, leaving Sign in. The appearance cards now support mouse dragging and touch swiping, and the indicators have been removed.

The drag and card-control test passed. Lint and typecheck passed with two existing navigation warnings.
